correction_lineage.only_contract_change: apply source-subset Atom_ID eligibility before every target-dependent phase

goal: honest all-label macro one-shared-q CCC >= 0.95 for unseen-entry evidence assimilation
success_and_retention: CCC >= 0.95 is the project stop criterion. This K=8 source gate can select the mechanism only for K=32 follow-up and cannot itself retain or rank a primary candidate. After K=32 qualification, a checks-passing formal iteration may be retained when it strictly improves the named baseline even if it does not yet stop the project.
primary_metric: For A_to_B, train on source fold A and score fold B; for B_to_A, train on source fold B and score fold A. For each canonical Atom_ID in .auto/frozen/all_label_inventory.json, concatenate every finite assigned row from both scored directions and compute population-moment CCC using sum_k q_e[k]*support_prediction[e,row,k], with one softmax-simplex q_e shared by every row in entry e; take the unweighted mean over the frozen eligible inventory. Inventory eligibility depends only on finite targets with at least two observations and nonzero target variance before predictions exist. Constant predictions remain scored; any missing or nonfinite prediction invalidates the candidate.
hypothesis: Routing chemical-shift data-loss gradients through the analytic chi1-chi4 Jacobian of emitted complete coordinates into continuously updated values of five input-nearest interresidue H/C/N/O/S distances will improve shared-q assimilation over the identical path with the coordinate Jacobian zeroed; nearest-atom identities and Jacobians stay frozen during assimilation.
implementation_isolation: The retained Run 98 candidate gpuopt/candidates/torsion_assimilator.py remains byte-unchanged; this source-only mechanism lives in gpuopt/candidates/corrected_k8_dynamic_coordinate.py and is not a formal candidate.

loss.observer: AdamW for 1024 fixed-final epochs on the source fold minimizes sum_i w_i SmoothL1(mean_k prediction_ik - normalized_target_i), where w_i is inverse source-fold Atom_ID count and is normalized to mean one.
loss.assimilation: Adam for 100 fixed steps minimizes mean_i w_i*(sum_k q_e(i)k*prediction_ik + bounded_family_reference_e(i)/source_cell_scale_i - normalized_target_i)^2 + 0.03*mean(tanh(delta_raw)^2) + 0.003*mean(KL(q_e||uniform)) + 0.003*mean(tanh(reference_raw)^2).
loss.normalization: center and scale are fit only on the opposite source training fold for each Comp_ID x Atom_ID cell; reference bounds are also calibrated only from that training fold
loss.ccc_role: source-OOF gate and frozen primary evaluation only

gradient_path: all source chemical-shift rows admitted by frozen source-subset Atom_ID eligibility
gradient_attribution: The reported coordinate-generator gradient norm is computed from chemical-shift data loss alone before torsion, q, or reference regularizers are added.
parameter_scopes: Observer training updates only observer weights. Evidence assimilation freezes the observer and independently optimizes q, reference, and delta from zero: q is one 8-support softmax vector per evidence-assimilated entry; reference is one bounded H/C/N vector per entry; delta is one bounded chi1-chi4 vector per residue and support.

frozen_hyperparameters_for_this_gate.phi_psi_policy: disabled because the dynamic coordinate descriptor path has no backbone Jacobian; retaining movable backbone variables would create an unscored emitted-coordinate path

controls.no_coordinate: reuse the identical frozen observer, independently optimize shared q and reference offsets from zero, and fix the complete-coordinate geometry Jacobian to exactly zero
controls.uniform_q: independently optimize coordinate and reference variables from zero while fixing q exactly uniform

source_gate.data: Use only commitment entities with split=train and observer_fold A or B. Within A and separately within B, group whole sequence_cluster_id values; assign clusters in descending entity count and lexical-cluster tie order to the least-loaded of two halves; train on the other half, predict the held half, and concatenate both held halves without entity or sequence-cluster overlap.
source_gate.selection: candidate-minus-jacobian-zero macro Atom_ID CCC must be strictly greater than 0.0005 independently in source fold A, source fold B, and their combined source-OOF rows; the combined score must define every Atom_ID in the frozen all-label inventory. Constant predictions score normally; missing or nonfinite predictions fail.

eligibility.scope: independently within each fold x held-half observer-training subset and evidence-assimilation subset
eligibility.rule: frozen all-label inventory AND at least two finite target rows AND population target variance greater than 1e-15
eligibility.ordering: before crossfit anchor selection, normalization, observer fitting, reference-bound calibration, evidence assimilation, prediction, and coordinate audit
eligibility.separation: held-assimilation targets define only held-assimilation eligibility and never observer-training eligibility; observer-training targets define only observer-training eligibility
eligibility.identity_proof: runner receipts bind input, selected, and excluded entity_uid x target_id rows including exact source target values; the independent checker reconstructs all receipts from committed source targets and verifies fail-closed guards at every model phase

source_gate.independent_checker: reload entity-qualified identities, Atom_ID labels, target values, sequence clusters, and the exact frozen K=8 support roster independently from hash-committed source files; independently reconstruct the train and held-assimilation eligibility rows for each fold x held half and reject any receipt or runner-emitted OOF mismatch; recompute A, B, and combined source-OOF macro scores plus unweighted C/H/N Atom_ID-macro diagnostics for candidate, independently optimized no-coordinate, and independently optimized uniform-q surfaces; require candidate gain > 0.0005 over no-coordinate in all three and complete frozen-label coverage in the combined score, without using uniform-q or family diagnostics for gating; independently reload each committed input PDB and require byte-derived base coordinates and atom identities to equal the emitted no-evidence state, require complete valid atom-state indices, and audit every exact emitted K=8 source state for finite values, motion, <=1 Angstrom displacement, and >=0.5 Angstrom minimum distinct-atom distance; verify SHA-256 output hashes, the hard-coded external authorization repository ref and concrete Git-blob OID, authorization-bound Slurm job ID, and container-image hash; inspect every target-dependent model phase for a fail-closed eligibility guard and inspect train_observer and optimize_assimilation ASTs for absence of CCC; and apply the checker-owned threshold

physicality.scope: source gate: all 8 exact emitted support states for every held source entity; any later qualified formal evaluation: all 32 emitted support states for every evaluated entity in both directions
physicality.maximum_atom_displacement_angstrom: reject if any emitted atom moves more than 1.0 from that atom's input support coordinate
physicality.minimum_distinct_atom_distance_angstrom: within every individual support state, include all upper-triangle pairs of distinct coordinate records, including bonded, same-residue, and adjacent-residue pairs; reject if any pair is closer than 0.5. Exact bond-axis rotations preserve internal bond lengths, and this is the predeclared severe-clash gate rather than a complete force-field test

coordinate_linearization: For each target atom, support, and element H/C/N/O/S, freeze the nearest atom in a different residue at the input support, differentiate that distance with the exact residue-template chi1-chi4 axis and downstream-atom convention, and linearly update only those five descriptor channels during optimization; ties inherit deterministic PDB/KD-tree order and missing atoms produce a masked zero Jacobian.
